rationale: Price is at 87.8% of today's range and within 0.90% of the session high after a strong intraday move, with the last several 1-minute candles showing very low volume and price stalling near $10.97 — momentum appears to be fading at resistance rather than breaking out. Skipping preserves capital while the position resolves.
